channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: I picked out 6 amazing back-to-school gadgets for under $60 — these are the desk upgrades I recommend for work and study
item.description: Study smarter this school year with six practical back-to-school gadgets that all currently cost less than $60.

item.title: After months of silence, the first Googlebook has been spotted — and it looks nifty, but will anyone really care?
item.description: 'What's a Googlebook?' After months of silence, the first Googlebook has been spotted — but the reaction to these laptops remains muted or confused.

item.title: MySpace coming back — again — is no surprise; I’m only shocked it’s not been announced as the first all-AI social media platform
item.description: Myspace's owners promise a revival, but with myriad questions about the relaunch swirling, we can reach only one likely and unfortunate conclusion.

item.title: 'We can push the limits of technology to pursue something mind-blowing': Disney Worldbuilders looks like a must-watch for Disney Parks fans
item.description: Disney Worldbuilders, the new Disney+ documentary from director Leslie Iwerks, premieres on August 20, 2026, taking viewers behind the scenes with Disney Imagineers and creative leaders to reveal how iconic lands inspired by Star Wars, Pixar, Marvel, and more come to life.

item.title: AWS is helping vibe-coding startup Superblocks, and the implications are big
item.description: AWS now allows vibe coding tool Superblocks to be embedded into the private clouds of AWS customers. It's another step towards decoupling apps from models.

item.title: Don’t worry about the MacBook Air shortages — these official Apple refurbished deals are a better buy anyway
item.description: The MacBook Air is suffering shortages, but Apple’s refurbished store offers a great way to score a laptop deal.

item.title: The SpaceX Falcon Lunar Crash Is a Warning for Moon Bases
item.description: The risk of more debris hitting the moon is on the rise as the space race heats up.

item.title: New condo mortgage rules could mean delays, denials and higher costs
item.description: New underwriting requirements could add extra reviews and paperwork before many condo mortgages are approved. Buyers beware: Starting on Monday, new rules from Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac go into effect that could make it trickier to obtain a mortgage for a condo.

item.title: Who’s legally to blame for Anthropic and OpenAI’s autonomous AI hacks? It’s complicated
item.description: OpenAI and Anthropic admitted that their unreleased AI models escaped their sandboxes and hacked several companies in unprecedented cyberattacks. Who is legally to blame? Should prosecutors charge the two AI frontier labs? Can victims sue them? We spoke to lawyers who specialize in computer hacking laws to find out.

item.title: A study found 92% of workers over 50 showed signs of disordered sleep — these 3 ChatGPT tricks helped me switch off
item.description: Researchers have uncovered a hidden sleep crisis among workers my age — here are three ways I use ChatGPT to help me nod off.

item.title: Satechi Thunderbolt 5 CubeDock review: I finally found the ultimate docking station for creatives
item.description: The Satechi Thunderbolt 5 CubeDock is a compact desktop dock that features the latest Thunderbolt 5 connection, enabling up to 140W laptop charging and fast transfer speeds.

item.title: SpaceX earnings latest: Stock hits record low today, investors’ first glimpse into Q2 2026 AI spending results comes due
item.description: The report comes less than two months after the much-hyped IPO of Elon Musk’s rocket company, which has delivered less-than-stellar returns. Elon Musk’s SpaceX is gearing up for another milestone—its first-ever earnings report, which it is scheduled to deliver tomorrow, Tuesday, August 4 after the closing bell.

item.title: DesignArena creators raise $7.9 million to bring taste to AI models
item.description: DesignArena is used by 5.3 million people around the world, providing critical human evaluations to frontier labs.

item.title: RAMageddon is reportedly causing a MacBook Air shortage
item.description: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports that the global memory crunch is causing a MacBook Air shortage. Some variants of the popular laptop are backordered more than a month out.

item.title: OpenAI’s first brand trip puts influencers in the hot seat
item.description: OpenAI invited creators to a Hudson Valley retreat, sparking criticism over AI’s environmental impact and influencer marketing.

item.title: What the Hank Green fan backlash says about AI in the creator community
item.description: In an era of slop fatigue, creators who have built massive followings based on trust may discover there’s no easy prompt for winning it back. The line between acceptable and reprimandable AI use is blurrier than ever, and popular science YouTuber Hank Green is trying to navigate it amid a groundswell of public scrutiny.

item.title: Influencers draw backlash for attending OpenAI’s first luxury trip
item.description: OpenAI’s first-ever influencer brand trip is sparking online backlash as tensions over the use of AI continue.
